// Helper: load JSON fixture
const loadFixture = <T>(name: string): T =>
  JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, '{{FIXTURES_DIR}}', name), 'utf-8'));

// Helper: load CSV fixture (skip header row)
const loadCsvFixture = (name: string): string[][] =>
  readFileSync(join(__dirname, '{{FIXTURES_DIR}}', name), 'utf-8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter(l => l.trim())
    .slice(1)
    .map(l => l.split(','));
